items.name: Steel City Classic 2020
items.information: # The competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. Join us for Steel City Classic 2020 in the heart of downtown Pittsburgh! Once the steel capital of the world, Pittsburgh has reinvented itself to be a home for many diverse industries and is also the home of several world champion professional sports teams. A new champion will be crowned right here on March 21st, will it be you? We welcome competitors from all speeds and skill levels and all guests as well. Come and see all that the speedcubing community has to offer! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations Live results can be found on our WCA Live page, which will be available during the competition. Day 1 Events: 2x2x2 Cube, 3x3x3 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Pyraminx Day 2 Events: 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, Clock, Megaminx, 3x3x3 Blindfolded
